notes.title: Nystagmus Patch Notes 10040
notes.content:
[b]Hello! [/b]

We noticed some player has experienced the bug where items will stick on their hand. This is caused by when the game is played offline or without Steam. We have fixed this problem in this patch.

Also, we decided to change the gameplay mechanism so when you die you don't lose your unsaved items now.

Thank you for your support!


[u]Update Details[/u]
-Fixed the problem when items stuck on the player
-Fixed the problem when the player can't receive the Mind Lost Achievement
-Fixed when items don't register into Steam
-Fixed endings that cannot open to the credit list.
-Fixed the easter egg
-Fixed the problem for fences
-Fixed the player hint text
-Fixed the playground sequence blinking
-Fixed intro sequence blinking
-Changed some sequence appearance
-Changed some UI color
-Changed the item saving mechanism
-Added instruction text in the journal

notes.title: Nystagmus Patch Notes 10030
notes.content:
Hello! We have made a patch for this game, including the localization for Chinese. 
Here are the details.

-Fixed the localization issues, now you can change the language to Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
-Fixed overridden materials
-Fixed material highlight
-Fixed Notes materials
-Fixed auto-detection settings
-Added Traditional Chinese translation
-Added player hint text
-Changed intro logo animation


Thank you for your support!
